documents.text: The service includes a 30-day refund window for annual subscriptions. Refunds are processed within five business days after approval. The support team can review edge cases outside this standard window.
Nimbus Cloud stores backups every six hours with a 14-day retention period. Customers can restore any snapshot from the last 14 days through the admin console.

Offline dashboards are available in read-only mode after the 24-hour sync cache is populated. The mobile app cannot create new tickets while offline, but it can view existing tickets and cached reports.

The service includes 24/7 support, a 99.9% uptime SLA, and optional regional failover for enterprise accounts. Standard accounts receive email support and premium accounts receive a response time target of under 30 minutes.
